Find your PM support ↗
Site scoping & audits +

Early site reviews, verified quantities and counts, constraints, photos, and budget inputs. Start with a defined scope and a clearer view of what the work requires.

Project build-out +

Translate the site review into a bill of materials, contractor bid package, and project schedule.

Project management & retainers +

Project leadership from kickoff through commissioning and closeout, or reserved PM hours each month across a portfolio. Scale your capacity as the workload changes.

Turnkey delivery oversight +

End-to-end management of licensed electrical contractors, with licensing, insurance, and approval reviewed for each job.

MAPS was founded by Chris Johnson to give teams experienced project management capacity without the overhead of a permanent hire.

Over six years as a project manager, Chris managed more than $40 million in projects, delivering hundreds of them. He also led a team of approximately 20 project managers completing more than 700 projects and $60 million in annual revenue.
